title: A week of every bus in New York City
description:
A week of every bus in New York City, Monday to Sunday, in 60 seconds.

Each day is the average of that weekday in October 2026, so Saturday is a typical Saturday, not one particular one. Vehicles outside the New York City limits are faded and not counted. Colours: Local, Express and Select Bus.

Busiest moment: 3,679 buses, Monday at 8:00 am.
The daily averages use every October 2026 date in each timetable and leave out Columbus Day (October 12). October 31 is left out because the clocks change that night.
